caption: The drawing depicts a single object placed centrally on a neutral, off-white background. The object is a glass or crystal vessel in the form of a top hat, rendered in brown, amber, and golden hues. It features a wide, rounded brim and a deep, cylindrical body that narrows slightly towards the base. The surface of the vessel is adorned with geometric and star-like etched patterns, including lines, dots, and starbursts, which appear in lighter shades such as yellow and white. The inner rim and base display variations in transparency, with reflections and highlights indicating a polished, glassy texture. There are no other objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Amber Glass Hat
